verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas offers an MCP server and 'PlayCanvas Skills' that let AI coding agents inspect and modify project/scene data and verify results in the viewport, which is adjacent to AI working with in-product data, but there is no evidence of the product itself surfacing AI-generated insights, summaries, or suggestions to the user inside its UI — the described capability is agent-driven editing, not insight generation. missing for 10: dedicated AI insights/suggestions UI, evidence of proactive AI analysis or recommendations surfaced to users, independent confirmation of this workflow.
